signs.title: Signs It’s Time for New Siding
signs.intro: Small siding problems let water, pests and outside air get in behind your walls. Watch for these:
items: wave
Warping or buckling
Panels look wavy, bubbled or pulled away from the wall, often from heat or trapped moisture.
sun
Heavy fading or chalking
The color is washed out or leaves a powdery film on your hand: the surface is breaking down.
crack
Cracks, splits or holes
Even small cracks let wind-driven rain and insects in behind the siding.
gap
Loose or missing pieces
Gaps where panels no longer connect leave the wall underneath exposed.
drop
Moisture stains or soft spots
Stains near seams and corners can mean water is already getting behind the siding.
window
Cracked caulk around windows and doors
Gaps around openings are an easy way in for water and drafts.
signs.footer: If you’re seeing more than one of these, or the damage is spread across your home, it’s usually time for new siding.

faq.title: Siding Questions, Answered
items: How do I know it’s time to replace my siding?

Look for warping, heavy fading or chalking, cracks, loose pieces and moisture stains. When the siding is also brittle, or the damage is spread across your home, it no longer protects your home the way it should, and new siding is the right fix. We’ll take a look at your free estimate.
Is faded siding a problem?

Some fading is normal with age, especially on walls that get strong afternoon sun. It becomes a concern when the siding also feels chalky or brittle, or is cracking, warping or coming loose, because then it no longer protects your home the way it should.
Which siding brands do you install?
We partner with James Hardie for fiber cement siding and CertainTeed for vinyl siding, so you can choose from a wide range of colors and styles.
Can I replace my siding, roof and gutters at the same time?

Yes. Roofing, siding and gutters work together as one system, so if all three are aging at once, doing them together gives you one coordinated project, a matching look and no repeat labor later. If only one is worn out, a focused replacement may be all you need.
Do you offer financing?
Yes. We offer flexible financing, including no-payment and no-interest loan options. Ask about them at your free estimate.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes, we’re fully licensed and insured, and our ownership team brings 30 years of combined experience in home remodeling.

signs.title: Signs It’s Time for New Gutters
signs.intro: Your gutters protect your roofline, fascia, siding, landscaping and foundation. When they start to fail, the damage spreads quickly. Watch for these:
items: gap
Pulling away from the house
Gaps behind the gutter let water soak the fascia, soffit and siding.
wave
Sagging or uneven sections
Gutters need a slight slope toward the downspouts. Dips hold standing water, which adds weight and speeds up wear.
crack
Cracks, rust or split seams
Every open joint is another leak, and rust means the system is near the end of its life.
rain
Overflowing in normal rain
A sign of clogs, the wrong pitch, undersized gutters or blocked downspouts.
drop
Stained siding or rotting fascia
Peeling paint and dark streaks near the roofline are often the first sign water is escaping.
down
Downspouts that don’t drain away
Clogged, crushed or short downspouts dump water right beside your foundation.
signs.footer: Damage in several places, sagging along the run or rust usually means a new gutter system is the better long-term fix.

faq.title: Gutter Questions, Answered
items: How do I know it’s time for new gutters?

Watch for gutters pulling away from the house, sagging sections, cracks, rust or split seams, and overflowing in normal rain. Damage in several places or along the whole run means a new system is the better long-term fix. We’ll take a look at your free estimate.
Why are my gutters overflowing?

Sometimes it’s just a clog of leaves, shingle granules or debris. If they overflow in normal rain even when clear, the gutters may be pitched wrong, undersized or loose, or the downspouts may not be draining.
Can failing gutters damage my home?
Yes. Water that escapes or backs up can rot the fascia and soffit, stain and damage siding, wash out landscaping and collect near your foundation.
Do I need gutter guards?
Gutter guards keep leaves, debris and pests out of your gutters, so they don’t clog and you don’t have to climb up to clean them. We can add them when we install your new gutters.
Can I replace my gutters and roof at the same time?
Yes. Your roof and gutters work together to move water off and away from your home, so if both are aging, doing them together means one coordinated project and no repeat labor later.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes, we’re fully licensed and insured, and our ownership team brings 30 years of combined experience in home remodeling.

signs.title: Signs It’s Time for a New Roof
signs.intro: Waiting too long to replace a roof can lead to costly problems, from water damage to higher energy bills. Watch for these:
items: calendar
Your roof is 20+ years old
Most asphalt shingle roofs last 20 to 25 years. Past that, problems can form out of sight, even before you see a leak.
shingle
Curled, cracked or missing shingles
Damaged shingles can’t shed water the way they should, and just one missing shingle can turn into a leak.
granules
Granules in your gutters
Bald spots on the shingles and granules collecting in your gutters mean the shingles are breaking down.
drop
Leaks, stains or musty smells
Water stains on ceilings, peeling paint or mold in the attic often mean water is getting past worn shingles or flashing.
sag
Sagging spots or daylight in the attic
Dips, soft spots or sunlight peeking through the roof boards can mean the decking underneath is damaged.
bolt
Climbing energy bills
An aging roof lets heat escape in winter and traps it in summer, so your heating and cooling work overtime.
signs.footer: Seeing more than one of these, or damage across the whole roof? A full replacement usually makes more sense than patching. We recommend a roof inspection every 2–3 years, or after any major storm.

faq.title: Roofing Questions, Answered
items: How do I know it’s time to replace my roof?

Watch for curled, cracked or missing shingles, granules in your gutters, leaks or water stains, sagging spots and climbing energy bills. Age matters too: most asphalt shingle roofs last 20 to 25 years, and storm damage can shorten that. We’ll inspect your roof and tell you honestly what it needs.
Should I replace my shingles or the entire roofing system?

We recommend replacing the entire roofing system rather than just the shingles. While it might seem cost-effective to replace only the damaged shingles, repairs often provide only a temporary solution. An entire roofing system replacement ensures a longer lasting and more cost-effective outcome in the long run.
How long does a roof replacement take?

Our roofers can have your new roof installed in as little as one day, so you’re not dealing with construction around your home for a long period of time. The exact timing depends on the size of your roof, the material and the weather.
What roofing materials do you install?

We offer a variety of roofing options from GAF, from asphalt shingles to metal roofing, as well as flat roofs. Traditional shingles cost less; metal roofing is designed to last up to twice as long. We’ll help you choose the best option for your home and budget.
What does being a GAF Master Elite contractor mean for me?

GAF Master Elite is a status held by less than 2% of roofing companies. Certified installers follow strict guidelines and complete ongoing training, and GAF’s upgraded warranties, like the Golden Pledge, are available only through Master Elite contractors like us.
Will my insurance pay for a new roof?

Often, when the damage is sudden and storm-related: wind, hail, falling limbs or the weight of snow and ice. Old age and wear and tear usually aren’t covered. We offer free storm-damage inspections and can meet your adjuster on the roof.
Do you offer financing?
Yes. Spread the cost with flexible financing through Service Finance, LLC. Homeowners may qualify for delayed payments and even no-interest loans.

faq.title: Commercial Roofing Questions, Answered
items: What is the most common commercial roof style?
Flat roofs are the most common style for commercial buildings. They are easy to maintain and to replace.
Which flat roof system is right for my building?

TPO offers some of the best longevity and resists shrinking; EPDM is the affordable, traditional rubber roof; Mod Bit gives superior waterproofing; PVC is light and affordable. We’ll recommend the right one for your building and budget.
How long does a commercial roof replacement take?
Our commercial roof contractors can usually redo an entire flat roof in just one day, so your business operations aren’t held up.
What are the components of a commercial roof?
Common components include the roof membrane, insulation, flashings and drainage systems.
What should I look for in a commercial roofing contractor?

Consider their experience, licensing, insurance, customer reviews and the quality of the materials they use. Panda Exteriors is licensed and insured, a GAF Master Elite contractor and A-rated by the BBB.

faq.title: Solar Panel Questions, Answered
items: How do solar panels work?
Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity using photovoltaic cells. When sunlight hits these cells, it stimulates electrons, creating an electric current.
Do solar panels work at night or on cloudy days?
Solar panels need sunlight to produce power. They produce less on cloudy days and none at night, but battery storage lets you use solar energy stored during the day.
Do I need a new roof to get solar panels?

No. Solar panels are mounted on top of the roof you already have, which suits a roof in good shape. If your roof is nearing the end of its life, GAF solar shingles let you take care of your roof and solar in one project.
Can I add more panels later?
Yes. Panel systems are easier to upgrade or expand in the future than a solar roof, so you can start with the system that fits your budget today.
What warranty comes with solar panels?
Solar panels typically come with 25 to 30 year performance warranties, and our installation is backed by our own warranty and 100% satisfaction guarantee.
What are my solar financing options?
There are various options, including solar loans, leases and power purchase agreements. Talk to us about the best option for you, and ask about $1,500 off your solar project.
